prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1209; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle that failed to yield. Police report requested. Claimant reports shoulder pain and is not represented by an attorney. Initial contact made by phone.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from claimant. Claimant states the light was green for their direction of travel. Claimant describes sudden impact to the driver door and a jolt that pushed the shoulder against the seatbelt. Claimant was seen at urgent care the same day and reports ongoing shoulder pain with limited overhead reach.

Entry 3: Obtained photos of both vehicles from the claimant. Driver door damage is consistent with the reported side impact. Estimate requested from body shop. Advised claimant of right to seek medical care from a provider of their choice and to keep all treatment records and receipts.

Entry 4: Received urgent care records. Diagnosis noted as shoulder strain with recommendation for physical therapy and follow-up imaging. Claimant asked whether an attorney is required to file a bodily injury claim. Explained that representation is optional and that the claimant may consult one at any time.

Entry 5: Reviewed police report and witness contact information. Liability appears disputed by the other driver, but the statement and photos support the claimant's account. Scheduled follow-up call with claimant to request physical therapy records and a current status update on the shoulder injury.
